verdict.rationale: Bevy is a self-hosted, open-source Rust library under MIT/Apache 2.0 with no contracts, license fees or sales cuts, and it is added as a normal Rust dependency. Your project stays as your own code and assets, so leaving carries no lock-in. The Scene system can save and load ECS worlds, and glTF is supported for loading, but nothing in the evidence documents an explicit export path or the open formats used for saved data. Missing for 10: documented export of project or scene data in named open formats, glTF or other asset export rather than only import, and independent corroboration of clean migration away.
